name: Owari no Hi ~Kyouran Acme ni Oboreru Koibito~
original_name: 終わりの日 ～狂乱アクメに溺れる恋人～
source: It is an original cuckold novel game. Please enjoy the intricate thought of the three parties and the H scene of fury that unfolds in the fantasy world.
translation: 這是一款以戴綠帽為題材的原創文字冒險遊戲。請欣賞奇幻世界中三人之間錯綜複雜的心思，以及狂亂的性愛場面。
